text:
```yaml
name: C# GSDK Unit Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'csharp/**'
      - '.github/workflows/csharp-tests.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 10.0
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore csharp/GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build csharp/GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: dotnet test csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal
```
